answer: Beacon spot-check with heartbeat: each identity locks 70 credits for a key-bound heartbeat. An ivory beacon draws an eighth per epoch; the drawn identity answers in ten minutes with proof on the trellis. A miss costs 18; three misses burn the bond and ripple a warning; rented heartbeats fail the key check. 1,000 fakes pay 9 per epoch: 90,000 in ten epochs, 70,000 locked — 160,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents lock 70 once, pay 9 per epoch.
